SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section 1, Social Branch    Siddon,
REPORT
Date November 8, 19 38.

Subject Application for certificate of existence in respect of
"Modern Homes."

Made by D.S.I. Logan    Forwarded by C. Gudo

At 9.30 a.m., 8.11.38, Dr. L. NEUMANN, M.D., 1534 Route
des Soeurs (Apt. 32, 1st floor) and Mr. Rudolf PAULICK, B.A.,
(Architect), Apt. 16, House 7, 314 Hardoon Road, came to the
Special Branch with the attached letter and explained that
the "certificate of residence" for the firm known as "Modern
Homes," mentioned in the aforesaid letter, is required to
enable a cousin of Dr. Neumann, namely James Rahmig
(Architect), residing at 44 Mommsenst, Berlin, Germany, to
obtain the necessary papers to permit him to leave Germany
and come to Shanghai to take up an appointment with the
firm "Modern Homes."

The firm which is at present known as "Modern Homes"
was first established in 1934 at 651 Avenue Foch, by Messrs.
Richard and Rudolf Paulick when it was known as "The Modern
Home." At the end of 1935 the controlling interest in
the firm was bought by the China Import and Export Lumber
Co. Ltd. (Sassoon) and the showrooms were transferred to
694 Bubbling Well Road, but the venture was not successful
and on December 1st, 1936, ownership was assumed by Messrs.
Paulick aforesaid.

On January 1st 1937 the showrooms were removed to the
present address - 803 Bubbling Well Road.

The concern was registered with the local German
Consulate-General on February 17th, 1938.

Dr. Neumann has been resident in Shanghai since the
early part of 1936.

It was explained by Dr. Neumann that his cousin would
like to leave Germany on November 25th, therefore he would

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号
特务科第 1 股    Siddon，
报告
日期 1938 年 11 月 8 日。

事由 关于“Modern Homes”存续证明之申请。

由警司 Logan 呈报    由 C. Gudo 转呈

1938 年 11 月 8 日上午 9 时 30 分，L. NEUMANN 医生（医学博士），住址姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）1534 号（32 室，一楼），以及 Rudolf PAULICK 先生（文学士，建筑师），住址哈同路 314 号 7 幢 16 室，携附信来到特务科，并解释说，上述信中所提及的名为“Modern Homes”的商号所需的“居住证明”，是为了使 Neumann 医生的表亲 James Rahmig（建筑师，住址德国柏林 Mommsenst 街 44 号）能够获得必要的文件，以便获准离开德国前来上海，在“Modern Homes”商号任职。

目前名为“Modern Homes”的商号最初由 Richard 和 Rudolf Paulick 两位先生于 1934 年在福煦路 651 号创立，当时名为“The Modern Home”。1935 年底，该商号的控股权被中国进出口木材有限公司（沙逊）（China Import and Export Lumber Co. Ltd. (Sassoon)）收购，陈列室迁至静安寺路 694 号，但该经营并未成功，遂于 1936 年 12 月 1 日由前述 Paulick 两位先生重新接手所有权。

1937 年 1 月 1 日，陈列室迁至现址——静安寺路 803 号。

该机构已于 1938 年 2 月 17 日向当地德国总领事馆注册。

Neumann 医生自 1936 年初起便居住在上海。

Neumann 医生解释说，他的表亲希望于 11 月 25 日离开德国，因此他
